label: Order
caption: GIGI JORDAN V. AMY LAMANNA, SUPERINTENDENT, BEDFORD HILLS CORRECTIONAL FACILITY
text: UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicant, IT IS ORDERED that the December 19, 2022 order of the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit, case No. 20-3317, is hereby stayed pending further order of the undersigned or of the Court. It is further ordered that a response to the application be filed on or before Tuesday, December 27, 2022, by 4 p.m. (EST).
